summary: iter-116 Paytm retirement verification. Backend pytest 5/6 pass. Frontend (AdminKiosk /admin/kiosk) verified via Playwright: 'UPI QR' label rendered (no Paytm), Razorpay locked pill present, no Paytm toggle, helper text mentions 'Paytm has been retired'. One backend bug found: GET /api/admin/kiosk/qr-provider does NOT self-heal a legacy 'paytm' persisted value — it returns 'paytm' verbatim.

critical.issue: Read path does not self-heal legacy 'paytm' persisted value. When db.app_config.kiosk_qr_v1.provider='paytm', GET returns {provider:'paytm'} instead of 'razorpay'. Review-request feature (2) explicitly requires this. Root cause in /app/backend/routes/mess_menu_cal.py L660-667: admin_get_kiosk_qr_provider merges DEFAULT_QR_CFG with the DB doc so 'paytm' overrides the default. The self-heal logic only lives in the internal helper _kiosk_qr_provider() (L685-697) which is used by the order flow but NOT by the GET endpoint. Suggested fix: force `provider='razorpay'` in the GET response and also update the DB doc when a non-razorpay value is read (mirror _kiosk_qr_provider).

action_items: Fix GET /api/admin/kiosk/qr-provider to always return provider='razorpay' regardless of persisted legacy value, and self-heal the DB doc (mirror the _kiosk_qr_provider() helper). Currently only the order-placement path self-heals; the admin GET returns raw 'paytm' when persisted.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The only remaining bug is the GET /admin/kiosk/qr-provider not self-healing. Fix is a 2-line change in mess_menu_cal.py::admin_get_kiosk_qr_provider — always return 'razorpay' and update the DB doc when non-razorpay. Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iter116_paytm_retirement.py after fix; test_legacy_paytm_is_migrated should turn green. All frontend Paytm-retirement UI is already correct and needs no further work.
rca of the issue: The migration was applied to two of the three code paths (PUT endpoint, internal _kiosk_qr_provider helper used by order-create), but the admin GET endpoint (used by AdminKiosk.jsx::loadQrProvider on mount) still uses the pre-migration merge pattern which lets a legacy 'paytm' DB value override the default. Because the front-end AdminKiosk.jsx defensively coerces any non-razorpay response to razorpay in state (L194-198) and silently PUTs the migration, this bug is masked in the UI — but the API contract is still wrong and any other consumer (or automated migration verification) would see the stale 'paytm' value.
